source: SIAP / DGSIAP (Mexico) - SIACON and Datos Abiertos agricola/pecuario
covers_crops: all nationally monitored crops (cierre de la produccion agricola); livestock: bovino, porcino, ovino, caprino, ave, guajolote, abeja
basis_notes: T26 route check, all URLs fetched 2026-09-02. Admin-1 = estado (32). ROUTE A, SIAP Datos Abiertos, no login: annual 'Cierre' CSV files - agricola MUNICIPAL 2003-2025 but NACIONAL-only 1980-2002 (https://nube.agricultura.gob.mx/datosAbiertos/Agricola.php); pecuario MUNICIPAL 2006-2025 but NACIONAL-only 1980-2005 (https://nube.agricultura.gob.mx/datosAbiertos/Pecuario.php); an XLSX data dictionary covers 1980-2025. ROUTE B, SIACON (https://www.gob.mx/agricultura/dgsiap/prensa/sistema-de-informacion-agroalimentaria-de-consulta-siacon): that page states an annual 1980-2025 series for both the agricola and pecuario modules with state-level AND municipal-level query options, offered as a single downloadable 'SIACON' file; the page states no file format and mentions no registration.
notes: T26 VERDICT: TIER-1 PUBLIC ROUTE VERIFIED for admin-1 (estado) crop area/production and livestock inventories, no login, bulk CSV. LICENCE NOT VERIFIED AS OPEN: neither SIAP portal page carries a licence, only a 'Terminos y Condiciones' footer link; the general gob.mx terms (https://www.gob.mx/terminos, fetched) authorise download 'solamente para su uso personal y no para un uso comercial', forbid reproduction/public display, and state 'El Usuario no debera transferir los materiales a ningun tercero'. https://datos.gob.mx/libreusomx (the 'Libre Uso MX' licence) returned HTTP 403 and could NOT be fetched, so whether Libre Uso MX overrides those terms for SIAP open data is UNRESOLVED - treat redistribution or pinning of raw SIAP files as unclear pending that check. COVERAGE CAVEAT: through the open-data portal the pre-2003 (crops) / pre-2006 (livestock) files are national only, so the 1980+ state series depends on SIACON, whose file format and licence were not verified. The 'confidence' field here rates the route classification, not a data value.

Best of the five LatAm routes checked. The crop resource is a single rolling file whose name carries its vintage (estimaciones-agricolas-2026-03.csv), so source_version must record the CKAN resource id plus the file name, not just the dataset slug. UNVERIFIED: sibling packages senasa-existencias-ovinas and senasa-existencias-caprinas appear in the portal listing but were NOT fetched, so sheep/goat coverage and licence are unconfirmed; siia.gob.ar (SIIA) was not reached separately - datos.magyp.gob.ar is the ministry's CKAN portal and is the machine-readable route. The MAGyP 'Estimaciones Agricolas' area page (https://www.magyp.gob.ar/sitio/areas/estimaciones/, fetched) publishes only periodic reports and dashboards, no bulk series.

basis_notes: T26 route check, all URLs fetched 2026-09-02. Admin-1 = region. CROPS: https://www.odepa.gob.cl/cultivos-anuales-superficie offers three .xls, of which 'cultivosregional-1.xls' (/wp-content/uploads/2014/08/cultivosregional-1.xls) IS the REGIONAL series of superficie sembrada, produccion y rendimientos, 1980-2014/15, open download, no login; the ODEPA digital library record https://bibliotecadigital.odepa.gob.cl/handle/20.500.12650/71653 'Informacion regional de superficie sembrada, produccion y rendimientos anuales' holds a later file 'cultivosRegional18.03.22 (1).xls' (677 KB, posted 2022-06-22), open, with NO rights statement on the record. Both pages attribute the data as 'elaborado por Odepa con informacion del INE'. LIVESTOCK: https://www.odepa.gob.cl/existencias-de-bovinos-ovinos-y-equinos-3 serves 'Existencias-de-bovinos-ovinos-y-equinos.xls' covering 1991-2007 with NO regional breakdown shown. ENA 2025/26 (https://www.odepa.gob.cl/estadisticas-del-sector/estadisticas-productivas/encuesta-nacional-agropecuaria-2025-26) publishes a spreadsheet of regional surface and bovino/ovino/caprino inventories, executed by INE under ODEPA mandate, no login, but only for the survey season and only for the regions Arica y Parinacota and Atacama to Los Lagos continental.
notes: T26 VERDICT: MIXED. CROPS = TIER-1 PUBLIC ROUTE VERIFIED at admin-1 (region), .xls bulk, no login, continuous 1980-2014/15. LIVESTOCK = STATED NEGATIVE: no open REGIONAL inventory TIME SERIES was found - the ODEPA existencias file is national and stops at 2007, and ENA gives regional inventories only per survey season and with incomplete regional coverage. LICENCE: no licence statement appears on any ODEPA page or library record fetched (an absence verified, not a claim of permissiveness); INE Chile's own open-data licence IS CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://www.ine.gob.cl/terminos-de-uso-y-licencia-de-datos-abiertos, fetched: attribution, share-alike, no additional restrictions), and because ODEPA states the crop tables are built 'con informacion del INE' the licence that governs the ODEPA redistribution is UNRESOLVED. Format is legacy .xls, so any reader needs an xls path.

source: ICRISAT District Level Database (DLD) - T26 access and licence record
covers_crops: district-level agriculture (area, production, yield), livestock, census, infrastructure, environmental and biophysical variables
basis_notes: T26 access record, fetched 2026-09-02. Grain = district (admin-2 in India; state = admin-1). The Dataverse record (DOI 10.21421/D2/XFB1BZ, 'District Level Data (DLD) and Dashboard for Agriculture and Allied-sectors in India') describes 592 districts across 20 states, 1966-2017, in two variants: unapportioned (current district boundaries) and apportioned (adjusted to historical boundaries, 1991/1996/2001). The Dataverse deposit itself holds ONLY three documentation files - 'DLD Apportioned Data Documentation.pdf', 'DLD Unapportioned Data Documentation.pdf', 'Overview of District Level Database.docx' - each restricted=false; the DATA is not on Dataverse but on the DLD portal at http://data.icrisat.org/dld/ .
notes: T26 VERDICT: ACCESS AND REDISTRIBUTION NOT ESTABLISHED - treat as not permitted until the agreement text is read. The Dataverse JSON export (https://dataverse.icrisat.org/api/datasets/export?exporter=dataverse_json&persistentId=doi:10.21421/D2/XFB1BZ, fetched) shows NO license block ('license: NONE'), termsOfUse = 'Data and documents published in this dataset are licensed under ICRISAT Data Sharing Agreement' pointing at http://data.icrisat.org/document/ICRISAT-Data-Sharing-Agreement.html, and fileAccessRequest = true. The agreement text COULD NOT BE FETCHED: data.icrisat.org refused the TLS connection from here (ECONNREFUSED 111.93.13.169:443, 2026-09-02) for both /document/ICRISAT-Data-Sharing-Agreement.html and /dld/, and the fetch tool upgrades http:// to https://, so neither the agreement nor the download route was reachable today. A no-licence deposit plus fileAccessRequest=true plus an unreadable bespoke agreement is the opposite of an open route; this is consistent with the plan keeping ICRISAT out of v1 scope.
